metadata.description: A resume rendered to PDF keeps its contact block, its profile links and its citizenship and veteran status.
metadata.regression_of: 2026-09-25: the site's own resume renderer produced a clean, correct-looking PDF with no phone number and no email, because its JSON schema has no field for a contact block. Nothing errored and nothing warned. A resume with no way to contact its author is worse than no resume, and the only reason it was caught is that someone read the rendered text.
